app: AI-Weld Settings Library / Vectis Weld Recipe Control
purpose: Control when a tested mild steel weld setting can become an approved and locked production recipe.

status_definitions.baseline_reference: Collected starting data only. Not tested, not approved, and not production-ready.
status_definitions.test_required: Baseline setting requires a test coupon before approval can be considered.
status_definitions.test_in_progress: Test coupon has been started but not completed or approved.
status_definitions.test_passed: Test coupon result passed required weld review checks.
status_definitions.test_failed: Test coupon result failed one or more required weld review checks.
status_definitions.retest_required: A failed, rejected, adjusted, or questionable setup must be tested again before approval.
status_definitions.approved_for_lock: Tested recipe has been approved and may be intentionally locked.
status_definitions.locked_recipe: Approved recipe has been intentionally locked for production reuse.
status_definitions.rejected: Test result or recipe setup was rejected and cannot be locked without retest.

locking_rules.production_ready_rule: production_ready must remain false until approval_status is approved_for_lock and locked_recipe_id is assigned intentionally.
locking_rules.failed_test_rule: If test_status is test_failed, approval_status must be rejected or retest_required and production_ready must remain false.
locking_rules.rejected_test_rule: Rejected tests require retest before any approval_for_lock status is allowed.
locking_rules.locked_recipe_id_rule: locked_recipe_id must remain null until test_status is test_passed and approval_status is approved_for_lock.

approval_records.notes: Approval placeholder linked to baseline and test coupon. Cannot lock until test passes and approval is granted.
